sources.title: PP-OCRv6 Introduction - PaddleOCR Documentation
sources.snippet: PP-OCRv6 is the latest generation of the PP-OCR universal text recognition solution. Built on the newly designed PPLCNetV4 unified backbone, it offers tiny, small, and medium tiers targeting edge/IoT, mobile/desktop, and server scenarios respectively.

sources.title: PaddleOCR/docs/version3.x/algorithm/PP-OCRv6/PP-OCRv6.en.md at ... - GitHub
sources.snippet: PP-OCRv6 achieves a major breakthrough in language coverage—the medium/small tiers support 50 languages with a single unified model, including Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, and 46 Latin-script languages (tiny supports 49, excluding Japanese).
